purpose: Pre-repair Marina evidence preserved by regression tests; hashes use canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators.

authorization.stated_reason: D and E dock replacement ($8.26M project) in place of a State DBW loan that would have cost ~$4.5M in interest over 30 years
authorization.terms: Repaid from the total Transient Occupancy Tax generated in the Waterfront starting FY2025 until paid off, plus a one-time $500,000 interest payment from TOT. Staff estimated the General Fund loses $1.0-1.5M/yr of TOT revenue until repayment is complete.
authorization.note: The May 2025 staff deck lists '$5.5M from Workers Comp fund for capital projects' under FY24. The FY2024 ACFR records no interfund loan receipt by the Marina Operations fund and no amount due from it at June 30, 2024. The FY2025 ACFR records a $2,477,099 interfund loan receipt, shown as due to the General Fund. How the $5.5M was booked is an open question (see status).
